use_when: Reserving a square, correctly sized, correctly coloured box for an icon inside another component — the trailing mark in a Button, the leading mark in a Chip.
dont_use_when: As an icon in its own right: the arrow it ships with is a placeholder and every production use should pass the real icon from Sunim Icon through the icon prop. As a decorative rule or spacer: it is a slot for meaning-bearing or label-adjacent marks, not a spacing device. At a size other than 14, 16 or 22 — the Figma set defines three and a fourth would be invented.
placement: Inside another component, next to a text label. It is not laid out directly on a page.
a11y: Two modes, chosen by whether label is set. Without it the slot is decorative and aria-hidden, which is correct beside a label that already says the same thing — that is how Button and Chip use it. With it, the slot becomes role="img" with that label as its accessible name, for when the icon is the only thing carrying meaning. It is never focusable and has no interactive state. Colour is inherited through --sunim-IconSlot-color so a consumer on a dark or accent surface can retint it without out-specifying its rules; contrast is therefore the consumer's to meet, not this component's.
